stories.title: Clean Harbors explosion leaves one worker injured; containment efforts continue overnight
stories.summary: One worker is in stable condition after the Clean Harbors explosion. Officials say the tank contained industrial wastewater and suspected hydrocarbons.

stories.title: 'No helmet, no ride' | Fulshear unanimously approves new bike and e-scooter safety ordinance
stories.summary: Fulshear City Council unanimously approved a "No Helmet, No Ride" ordinance requiring helmets for e-bike, e-scooter and traditional bicycle riders.

stories.title: Houston shrimp investigation finds nearly half of sampled restaurants misrepresented imported seafood
stories.summary: An investigation found that 10 of 22 Houston restaurants tested served imported shrimp while misrepresenting it as local, American wild-caught or Gulf shrimp.

stories.title: Portillo's has closed these three locations in the Houston area
stories.summary: The Chicago-based restaurant confirmed to KHOU 11 that three of them were closed Nov. 15.

stories.title: 'I just heard a pop' | Neighbors react after 8-month-old baby shot in northwest Houston
stories.summary: Advocates say the shooting is another reminder about properly handling and storing firearms.

stories.title: 15 defendants, including Houston woman, charged in nationwide VA benefits fraud crackdown
stories.summary: The Department of Justice’s National Fraud Enforcement Division called the operation its first-ever coordinated national enforcement action focusing on VA benefits.

stories.title: School districts make changes after failing to report bus crashes
stories.summary: KHOU 11 Investigates had identified nine Houston-area districts with reporting problems.

stories.title: HPD: 40-year-old man seriously injured after argument turns violent in southeast Houston
stories.summary: A 40-year-old man was shot during an argument in southeast Houston. Police are investigating reports that the victim and a suspect were on a METRO bus.

stories.title: Houston increases homebuyer assistance to $75,000 as housing market faces challenges
stories.summary: Houston is increasing financial assistance for eligible homebuyers as city leaders look to expand homeownership opportunities amid a challenging housing market.

stories.title: Harris County Sheriff's Office prepares for ICE agreement under new Texas law
stories.summary: The Harris County Sheriff's Office said it intends to comply with a new state law requiring an ICE partnership.

stories.title: Pilot charged in deadly 2024 Houston Ship Channel collision
stories.summary: A ship pilot faces a federal charge alleging his negligence caused a 2024 Houston Ship Channel collision that killed Aquarius Lowman.

stories.title: Nearly 300 people charged in South Texas immigration, border enforcement cases between Nov. 6-12
stories.summary: Federal prosecutors said 297 people face charges in South Texas immigration and border enforcement cases filed Nov. 6-12.
